$comment: Reviewed exceptions to the owner-gates node lane (#750). Each entry is a node test path or one-level glob that a .github/workflows/*.yml node command runs and the local lane does not, with the reason and the ticket that owns closing the gap. owner-gates prints them as node-excepted=…; owner-gates-tools.test.mjs fails on an entry without reason or ticket, or one that matches no CI test.

exceptions.reason: CI runs these host-ownership integration tests as `scripts/heavy-lock.sh node scripts/tdd/node-lane.mjs …` with MADO_HEAVY_CI_BOUNDARY_REQUIRED=1 and a CI top-level lock input; node-lane.mjs refuses without that supervision boundary, and the owner-gates node lane takes no heavy lock.
